bio: The way into this trendy, vibrant restaurant on two floors is through a courtyard. The service is friendly and relaxed; the food is seasonal German cuisine, with a menu featuring appetising dishes such as glazed beef cheeks with mashed potatoes. The Chef's Choice three-course set menu is available in both a meat and a vegetarian version. There is a delightful courtyard terrace, and Tiger Bar is also part of the same address. Just across the road is the Wintergarten variety theatre....
